What Trimugo does

We take product ideas from an initial conversation to a live release, helping founders turn a clear vision into working software. We also turn operational processes that still run on email, spreadsheets and manual re-typing into connected systems, giving businesses a more dependable way to work.

In practice that means freelance and contract engineering in React, Vue, TypeScript and React Native, backed by Node.js and PostgreSQL, integrated against the CRM, ERP and third-party APIs a client already runs. AI agents and document intelligence are offered where a project genuinely calls for them and declined where they do not.

Where to find Trimugo

Find Trimugo online at trimugo.in. Explore Malisetti Obulamurthy's code at github.com/Murthy-sys. Shipped products are listed on the selected work page, with links to open and use each product.

How Trimugo works with clients

Engagements are remote and structured around defined milestones, product demos and written documentation of architecture and integrations. Scope, priorities and review points are agreed together, with direct access to the engineers building the product.

Who actually does the work?

Trimugo is a group of engineers working together across product design, architecture, development and delivery. Cimala Gowthami is Founder and CEO, and Malisetti Obulamurthy is Founder and CTO. You collaborate directly with the engineers building your product.

Do you work as a freelance developer or on a contract basis?

Both. A freelance engagement takes a defined project from scope to release. A contract engagement supports ongoing development within your team, repositories and release process. In either case, you work directly with the engineers building the product.

Do you only work with European companies?

No. Based in Bangalore, India, we work remotely with clients worldwide, including Europe and the UK, the US, India and the wider APAC region. Delivery is structured around milestones, product demos and written documentation, with direct access to the engineers doing the work.

Trimugo is a group of engineers working together to bring your product to life. You collaborate directly with the people building it.
